author: S. E. Schwab
title: Central Missouri Jennies softball reschedules doubleheader due to weather forecast
text:
The Central Missouri Jennies softball team announced on Apr. 8 that it has changed its upcoming schedule because of expected bad weather.
The team’s doubleheader against Washburn, which was originally set for Friday, April 10, will now take place on Thursday, April 9. The games will be held during Campus Cupboard Day at Jennies Field in the South Recreation Complex in Warrensburg, with the first game starting at 3:00 p.m.
Fans attending the contests against Washburn can receive free admission by donating canned food items at the ticket window of the South Recreation Complex.
The Jennies currently hold a record of 26-12 overall and are 9-5 in Mid-America Intercollegiate Athletics Association play. They are on a four-game winning streak after sweeping conference doubleheaders against Rogers State and Northeastern State.
For updates about Central Missouri athletics, fans are encouraged to follow @UCMAthletics on X (formerly Twitter), Instagram, and Facebook.
